title: Firefox cache (Snap)
whyItMatters: Cached copies of pages and images you viewed in the Snap build of Firefox, the default on Ubuntu. Sizes and dates alone show when the browser was used.
source: Snap confinement keeps per-user data under ~/snap/<name>/common (snapcraft.io/docs/data-locations); observed created by Firefox snap 160 on Ubuntu 24.04 by Claude
notes: Snap counterpart of browser.firefox.cache, whose native path is ~/.cache/mozilla/firefox. Folder sizes only; cache files are never opened.

steps: Close every Firefox window, including the tray icon, so the cache files are not in use.
Open the Files app, press Ctrl+H to show hidden folders, and find the cache folder named in the plan.
Move that folder to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Only cached copies of pages and images are lost. Firefox rebuilds the cache as you browse; history, bookmarks and saved logins stay.
cleanup.source: Mozilla Support, How to clear the Firefox cache: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/how-clear-firefox-cache
